sections.markdown:
## C2 - KG handoff - sec04 license types, ID documents

FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A01
Class D scope groups with age and weight limits. [A01]
Why it matters: cluster license-class facts together.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A02
Class A/B/C scope groups with combined-weight limits. [A02]
Why it matters: separate commercial classes from Class D.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A03
Endorsement codes group hazmat, tanker and passenger uses. [A03]
Why it matters: cluster endorsements apart from restrictions.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A04
Restriction codes limit vehicle, speed and medical conditions. [A04]
Why it matters: keep restriction letters apart from endorsements.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A05
Identity, residence and driving-experience proofs form the triad. [A05]
Why it matters: missing-document visits fail before testing.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A06
Renewal, replacement and address-change duties group by timing. [A06]
Why it matters: due-date rules confuse renewal with replacement.
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0028]

Confusables: DPC versus limited-term versus regular Class D; endorsement versus restriction codes.
Prereqs: learn license-class scope before endorsements and restrictions; learn document triad before DPC extras.
